body.claim: Shopify's discount combination settings control whether staff POS discounts can stack with other automatic or code-based discounts on the same order.
body.query: how do Shopify discount combination settings work for staff POS discounts

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Discount combinations on POS
sources.passage: When you process a sale in Shopify POS, you can apply both automatic discounts and discount codes that you've configured in your Shopify admin, as well as custom discounts that are specific to the transaction. When multiple discounts apply to the same order, customers benefit from the best possible total discount based on their cart. All automatic discounts and discount codes follow the same combination rules and calculation order as online orders. For stores that are on the Shopify Plus plan, combining multiple products discounts on the same line item is supported on POS.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Combining discounts
sources.passage: To combine multiple product discounts on the same line item, your store must be on the Shopify Plus plan. For products that are part of a Buy X get Y discount, the following scenarios apply depending on the Shopify subscription plan that your store is on: For Shopify Plus: The customer-gets product in a Buy X get Y discount is eligible for combining product discounts on the same line item. If a customer enters a discount code for the customer-buys product of a Buy X get Y discount, then the best value overall discount is applied for the customer. Better discount applied: When multiple discounts apply to the same items and can't be combined, then Shopify automatically applies the best discount for the customer. If an automatic discount isn't applying alongside a customer's discount code, then verify the following settings and limits: Check discount eligibility: Confirm that all products in the cart meet the requirements for both discounts. If a product doesn't qualify for one of the discounts, then the combination might not work as expected.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Discounts in Shopify POS
sources.passage: # Discounts in Shopify POS You can apply custom discounts to line items or to the whole cart in Shopify POS. Each discount that you create has one of the following types depending on what the discount applies to: If you have set up automatic discounts and discount codes in your Shopify admin, then you can add and combine these discounts in the Shopify POS checkout. If you currently use a third-party discount app to create and manage your discounts for your online store, then you can use the same discounts on Shopify POS. #### Note Learn more about managing discount eligibility for specific markets. ### In this section Overview of managing discounts on Shopify POS Discount combinations on POS Applying discounts in the Shopify POS app

quotes.quote: When you process a sale in Shopify POS, you can apply both automatic discounts and discount codes that you've configured in your Shopify admin, as well as custom discounts that are specific to the transaction.
If an automatic discount isn't applying alongside a customer's discount code, then verify the following settings and limits: Check discount eligibility:

body.explanation: The passages explain that automatic discounts and discount codes can be applied together in POS and mention checking eligibility when they do not combine, but they do not state that any discount combination setting controls whether staff POS discounts can stack with other discounts. Therefore the claim is neither confirmed nor denied by the provided text.
body.nextCheck: In the Shopify admin, open the Discounts page and look for the combination settings that govern how automatic discounts and discount codes interact with manual POS discounts.

body.claim: Shopify's return policy settings allow merchants to set a custom return window for orders fulfilled by the merchant.
body.query: how to set return window duration in Shopify admin

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Setting up return and cancellation rules
sources.passage: To allow customers to request returns or cancellations, you need to turn on self-serve returns and cancellations in your online store. Return rules apply to fulfilled items, and determine when customers can request a return. The return window information comes from the settings that you configure in the Policies section of your Shopify admin. For example, for customers in the European Union you might set the cancellation window to Until item is fulfilled and a return window of at least 14 days to support the EU right of withdrawal, and apply a shorter standard return window elsewhere.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Return rules
sources.passage: You can manage your return rules in Settings > Policies section of your Shopify admin. For example, a frequent customer requests a return or a customer requests a return one day after the return window ends. You need to have return rules set up in your Shopify admin. The return window is the amount of time the customer has to return a product after purchase.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Setting up self-serve returns and cancellations
sources.passage: ## Activate self-serve returns and cancellations To set up return and cancellation requests, you need to activate self-serve returns and cancellations in your Shopify admin. To do that, you can set up customer accounts in your Shopify admin or add the customer accounts URL to your store. #### Steps: 1. From your Shopify admin, go to Settings > Customer accounts. Activate self-serve returns and cancellations in your Shopify admin Give customers access to sign in to customer accounts using one of the following methods: + Upgrade to customer accounts. + Add the URL for customer accounts to your store's footer, refund policy, or another page in your store.

quotes.quote: The return window information comes from the settings that you configure in the Policies section of your Shopify admin.
You can manage your return rules in Settings > Policies section of your Shopify admin.

body.explanation: The quoted text shows that return windows are defined in the Policies settings where merchants can adjust the length. Because the setting exists, a merchant can change the window to a different length if desired.
body.nextCheck: In your Shopify admin, go to Settings > Policies and look for the return window field to see if it can be edited to another length. If the field is present and editable, you can proceed with the change.
